items.item: Explains remote events are not ordered relative to attribute/property replication
Explains streaming: the door may not exist on distant clients (nil)
Recommends driving the client from replicated state (GetAttributeChangedSignal / CollectionService component) instead of the remote, or passing state in the payload
Mentions handling stream-in (instance added later) / ModelStreamingMode or WaitForChild with timeout

incorrect_or_stale: Suggests WaitForChild with a timeout for a door that may be streaming in, but when the door is passed as a remote argument it arrives as nil, so there is nothing to call WaitForChild on. That advice only works with a path or name lookup.

raw.reason: Both diagnose the problem correctly and give the same state-driven fix, but B also explains how to reproduce it (Network Simulator, a far-away client, debug prints) and adds the snap-vs-animate rule on stream-in, while A skips reproduction and its WaitForChild tip doesn't fit the nil-argument case.
